description: Late Iron Age - Early Roman Farmstead, with a central enclosure and rectangular building. Based on morphology this has been suggested to be a shrine. The abandonment of the site is uncertain, but the RSRB suggests it did not last long into the 4th CE.
bibliography: Luke, and T Preece. “Farm and Forge: Late Iron Age/Romano-British Farmsteads at Marsh Leys, Kempston.” Bedfordshire East Anglian Archaeology 138 (2011).
Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Marsh Leys, Kempston, Farmstead 2/4 (Bedfordshire).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
